value.deck: Microsoft is ending support for Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS, a critical update for data teams managing cloud-based data processing environments.
shortVersion: Microsoft has announced that Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS will reach its End of Life (EOL) on November 1, 2026. After this date, the runtime will no longer receive essential security patches, bug fixes, or technical support, creating potential risks for any systems still using it.

This means that data engineering teams currently running their workloads on this specific runtime must plan and execute a migration to a newer, supported version before the deadline. Failing to do so could leave their data processing environments vulnerable to security threats and operational issues due to a lack of vendor support.

This announcement is part of a broader trend in cloud computing, where software versions are regularly updated and deprecated, requiring users to proactively manage their infrastructure. It underscores the importance of staying current with cloud service updates to maintain system integrity and security.
value.plainLanguage: Microsoft is stopping support for an older version of its Azure Databricks software, requiring users to update by November 2026 to keep their data systems secure and supported.

value.whyItMatters: For organizations and data professionals utilizing Azure Databricks, failing to migrate from Runtime 10.4 LTS by the November 2026 deadline will expose their data processing pipelines to security vulnerabilities and potential operational disruptions due to lack of support, necessitating a planned upgrade.
